module: Node "Random Color" (repeat_instant, casino icon). Provides a random color {r, g, b, a} every frame. Inputs: cuteColor (only highly saturated colors), randomAlpha (random alpha, otherwise 1). Output: color.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Generates a color: in cuteColor mode via HSVtoRGB with a random hue and saturation/value between 0.7 and 1; otherwise three random components.
